analysis:
Integration across 38 units. No concrete security regression is established from the supplied evidence. The PR is mostly documentation and changelog fragments, plus GLM5-Next provider changes in Swift.

I did not adopt the low-severity finding from unit 2. It concerns a documentation-only description of the cached verified-weight-hash, and no code defect or control change is shown. It is recorded below as an unverified contract.

Key changes examined:
(1) GLM weight-hash flow. GLM5NextManagedLoad.verifiedArtifactSHA256 is set only after construction and a successful file-identity recheck (unit 33/34). VerifiedWeightHashStore (~/.darkbloom/verified-weights.json, 0600, bound to device, inode, size, mtime and ctime) lets a coordinator-mode start skip rehashing. Its implementation, and the callers that publish the hash to the coordinator, are not in the supplied evidence. Open questions for T-012, T-027 and A-004: integrity of the owner-writable record against a local operator (ADV-001) who can forge a record, what the stat-tuple threat model covers, and whether TOCTOU between registration and load is closed. Operator weight tampering and a self-reported hash were already accepted limits. DARKBLOOM_VERIFIED_WEIGHTS_FILE was added to the qualification operationalKeys (unit 34) and is redirected to a 0700 directory in NativeServeQualification (units 26/27); this is hardening.
(2) GLM structured output and forced tool_choice. The previous up-front refusals are replaced by output withholding and post-generation validation (GLM5NextPromptPolicy, GLM5NextResponseFormat, ToolChoiceEnforcementPolicy, MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngine). The reviewed units show a fail-closed design: 422 without content, media plus withheld modes refused with releaseBox.fire(), and the generic error mapping unchanged. Unverified: the router.streamsToolCalls branch and non-streaming paths must never emit unvalidated GLM output, and bounded buffering. This relates to T-008 and A-001.
(3) EngineV2Bridge.nativeOutputControlRefusal and the new unsupportedOutputControl error run before any reservation or cache staging. They return a 400 with a fixed content-free message. This is an availability improvement (T-010 class). The prefix constant and status mapping are outside the evidence.
(4) SystemMemory reclaimable now counts page cache as available, which can over-admit loads. This is an availability and OOM trade-off with no confidentiality effect.
(5) The libs/mlx-swift-lm submodule bump (7bed821 to baca4ac) was not reviewable (T-028, T-041 and TB-007 depend on it).
(6) T-041 SSD cache controls (HMAC names, 30-minute TTL, scope salt) are untouched.
(7) VFR video decode and the Flint untyped-schema acceptance widen input parsing. GLM5NextProcessor and the T-050 temp-file behavior were not supplied.

Deeper review is needed for the unsupplied source files: VerifiedWeightHashStore, ProviderLoop.verifiedGLM5NextWeightHash, WeightHasher, the GLM5NextProcessor VFR path, the submodule diff, and the GLM withholding enforcement in the engine.
